==Russian==

===Etymology===
{{ety|ru|:inh|orv:нести|tree=1}}
{{inh+|ru|orv|нести}}, from {{inh|ru|sla-pro|*nestì}}.

===Pronunciation===
* {{ru-IPA|нести́}}
* {{audio|ru|Ru-нести.ogg}}

===Verb===
{{ru-verb|нести́|impf|pf=понести́|vn=несе́ние}}

# to [[bear]], to [[bring]], to [[carry]]
#: {{uxi|ru|'''нести́''' [[тяжёлый|тяжёлые]] [[сумка|су́мки]]|'''to carry''' heavy bags}}
# to [[carry]], to [[bear]], to [[support]]
#: {{ux|ru|[[они|Они́]] [[должен|должны́]] '''нести́''' [[отве́тственность]] [[за]] [[ошибка|оши́бки]].|They need '''to bear''' responsibility for the mistakes.}}
# to [[lay]] (eggs)
#: {{pf|ru|снести́}}
# {{lb|ru|colloquial|pejorative}} to [[talk]] (about), to [[babble]] on (about)
#: {{uxi|ru|[[что]] ([[за]] [[вздор]]) [[он]] '''несёт'''!|what (utter) nonsense he is talking!}}
#: {{uxi|ru|[[не]] [[понимать|понима́ю]], [[что]] [[она́]] [[там]] '''несёт'''|I have no idea what she is babbling on about}}
# {{lb|ru|colloquial}} to [[be]] [[carried away]], to [[go]] over the [[limit]]s

====Usage notes====
* {{U:sla:directional verb|ru|uni|impf=нести́|pf=понести́|othimpf=носи́ть|othpf=поноси́ть}}

====Conjugation====

==Russian==

===Etymology===
{{inh+|ru|sla-pro|*rodìti}}.

===Pronunciation===
* {{ru-IPA|роди́ть}}
* {{audio|ru|Ru-родить.ogg}}

===Verb===
{{ru-verb|роди́ть|both|impf=рожда́ть,рожа́ть|vn=рожде́ние}}

# to [[give birth]]
# to [[give rise to]]
# to [[bear]], to [[yield]] {{q|of [[land]]}}

====Usage notes====
* The usage of this verb in the imperfective is dated. Modern Russian allows only the use as a perfective.
* All forms are identical between the perfective and imperfective conjugation, with the exception of {{l|ru|родила́|tr=-}} (pf) / {{l|ru|роди́ла|tr=-}} (impf) and inevitable differences due to the aspect: the perfective has no present participles and uses the present forms of the imperfective for the future.

====Conjugation====
''perfective:''
{{ru-conj|pf|4b/c+pжд|роди́ть}}
{{ru-conj|pf|4b/c+pжд|роди́ть|old=1}}
''imperfective (dated):''
{{ru-conj|impf|4b+pжд|роди́ть}}
{{ru-conj|impf|4b+pжд|роди́ть|old=1}}
